'''Evan Fitzgerald''' (forum handle '''PapaLorax''')<ref name="enc2008">[https://web.archive.org/web/20080803132637/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=Encyclopedia Encyclopedia: Volunteer Information], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 3 August 2008)</ref> was a volunteer of the [[Players Committee]].

In a PC announcement of 22 June 2007, Fitzgerald was named to step in for Rules Advocate [[Charles Sonnenburg]] on an interim basis, primarily to finish work on the Advanced Rules document.<ref name="ref2007">[https://web.archive.org/web/20070927192625/http://www.swccgpc.com/ The SWCCG Player's Committee], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 27 September 2007; PC Announcements of 22 June and 12 July 2007)</ref> The Encyclopedia's Volunteer Information of 3 August 2008 lists him as Website Admin.<ref name="enc2008" />
